spellData.desc: Empower your next Attack to deal bonus damage and make enemy champions bleed, revealing them.
Throw blades that return to you, damaging and slowing enemies on both passes.
Blink behind a target. Silence enemies and amplify your damage against them.
Scatter blades and become invisible with increased Move Speed. The blades return when you reappear.

passLev1Desc: Your Attacks deal more damage to enemies affected by certain crowd control effects.
